channel.description: Authority for Anti-Money Laundering and Countering the Financing of Terrorism | News articles

item.title: AMLA launches survey on Central Contact Points
item.description: Share your experience: AMLA is inviting Electronic Money Institutions (EMIs) and Payment Service Providers (PSPs) to provide feedback on their experience with the current Central Contact Point (CCP) framework pursuant to Article 45 (9) AMLD and Delegated Regulation (EU) 2018/1108.
item.category: Authority for Anti-Money Laundering and Countering the Financing of Terrorism

item.title: EBA publishes draft reporting framework for the 2027 eligibility data collection
item.description: As part of release 4.4 of its reporting framework, the European Banking Authority (EBA) has published a public working draft of the data model and taxonomy that will support the collection of data on eligibility for direct supervision by AMLA.
item.category: Authority for Anti-Money Laundering and Countering the Financing of Terrorism

item.title: Press Release: AMLA finalises common formats for FIU cooperation and reporting to the EPPO
item.description: AMLA has finalised three sets of standards that will help financial intelligence move across the EU faster and more consistently.
item.category: Authority for Anti-Money Laundering and Countering the Financing of Terrorism

item.title: Frequently asked questions on the reporting package for identifying provisionally eligible entities
item.description: AMLA has published a document answering the questions most frequently raised about the reporting package on the identification of provisionally eligible obliged entities.
item.category: Authority for Anti-Money Laundering and Countering the Financing of Terrorism

item.title: Press Release: AMLA finalises standards for supervisory cooperation in direct supervision
item.description: New standards set out how AMLA and national supervisors will cooperate to select and directly supervise some of the EU’s most significant cross-border financial institutions from 2028.
item.category: Authority for Anti-Money Laundering and Countering the Financing of Terrorism

item.title: Updated taxonomy for the 2027 risk assessment data collection
item.description: As part of its reporting framework release 4.3, the European Banking Authority (EBA) has published an updated version of the data model and taxonomy that will support the collection of data for AMLA's risk assessment of entities eligible for direct supervision.
item.category: Authority for Anti-Money Laundering and Countering the Financing of Terrorism

item.title: AMLA Chair presents 2025 Consolidated Annual Activity Report to the European Parliament
item.description: AMLA Chair Bruna Szego presented the Authority’s 2025 Consolidated Annual Activity Report at a public hearing of the European Parliament’s ECON and LIBE Committees.
item.category: Authority for Anti-Money Laundering and Countering the Financing of Terrorism

item.title: Press Release: AMLA consults on harmonised risk assessments in the non-financial sector
item.description: A shared methodology across the EU: AMLA is inviting views on draft rules that will determine how supervisors in every Member State assess money laundering and terrorism financing risks of businesses and professionals in the non-financial sector.
item.category: Authority for Anti-Money Laundering and Countering the Financing of Terrorism

item.title: Press Release: AMLA introduces a common EU approach to enforcing anti-money laundering rules
item.description: For the first time, supervisors across the EU will apply a harmonised, consistent approach to enforcing breaches of anti-money laundering and counter-terrorist-financing rules.
item.category: Authority for Anti-Money Laundering and Countering the Financing of Terrorism

item.title: Press Release: AMLA concludes public hearing on draft guidelines on ongoing monitoring of business relationships
item.description: On 2 July 2026, AMLA held a public hearing on the guidelines on ongoing monitoring of a business relationship, an important milestone in developing the EU's new AML/CFT framework and the risk-based approach.
item.category: Authority for Anti-Money Laundering and Countering the Financing of Terrorism

item.title: Press Release: AMLA launches public consultation on common format for reporting suspicions
item.description: A common reporting format for a united fight against financial crime: AMLA is inviting views on draft standards that harmonise how companies and professionals report suspicions across the EU.
item.category: Authority for Anti-Money Laundering and Countering the Financing of Terrorism

item.title: Press Release: AMLA consults on clear rules for cross-border FIU information exchanges
item.description: Cross-border information sharing between FIUs is set to become harmonised and more reliable. AMLA is inviting views on draft standards that will decide when a suspicious activity report concerns another EU country and should be shared with that country's Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU).
item.category: Authority for Anti-Money Laundering and Countering the Financing of Terrorism

item.title: Press Release: AMLA and EDPB to develop Joint Guidelines on partnerships for information sharing
item.description: AMLA and the European Data Protection Board (EDPB) are working together to bring greater clarity to a question of growing importance for industry and authorities alike: how to share information to fight financial crime while protecting personal data.
item.category: Authority for Anti-Money Laundering and Countering the Financing of Terrorism

item.title: Advisory note on money laundering risks as the MiCAR transitional period ends
item.description: AMLA has published an advisory note on the money laundering and terrorist financing risks linked to the end of the MiCAR transitional period on 1 July 2026.
item.category: Authority for Anti-Money Laundering and Countering the Financing of Terrorism

item.title: AMLA Executive Director Nicolas Vasse speaks at ACPR's Rencontres Anti-Blanchiment in Paris
item.description: AMLA Executive Director Nicolas Vasse delivered an address at the first edition of the Rencontres Anti-Blanchiment in Paris on 16 June 2026, organised by the ACPR, France's supervisory authority for the banking and insurance sectors.
item.category: Authority for Anti-Money Laundering and Countering the Financing of Terrorism

item.title: First AMLA Conference Recap: Key Moments and Insights
item.description: The recap of the AMLA conference is now available, featuring key insights, highlights, and videos from some of the event's most memorable moments. Explore and relive the conversations that made AMLA 2026 a milestone event.
item.category: Authority for Anti-Money Laundering and Countering the Financing of Terrorism

item.title: AMLA Successfully Concludes its First Conference
item.description: AMLA's first conference took place on 9 June 2026 at Alte Oper, Frankfurt am Main.
item.category: Authority for Anti-Money Laundering and Countering the Financing of Terrorism

item.title: First AMLA Conference
item.description: We are pleased to announce the first AMLA conference, taking place on 9 June 2026 at Alte Oper in Frankfurt am Main.
item.category: Authority for Anti-Money Laundering and Countering the Financing of Terrorism

item.title: Webinar materials now available: identifying obliged entities eligible for direct supervision
item.description: AMLA is today publishing the full set of materials from its webinar on the identification of obliged entities eligible for direct supervision, held on 10 June.
item.category: Authority for Anti-Money Laundering and Countering the Financing of Terrorism

item.title: AMLA consults on draft Guidelines on ongoing monitoring of business relationships
item.description: AMLA has today launched a public consultation on draft Guidelines setting out how obliged entities should carry out ongoing monitoring of their business relationships, including the monitoring of transactions and activities.
item.category: Authority for Anti-Money Laundering and Countering the Financing of Terrorism

item.title: AMLA takes next step toward 2027 selection of entities for direct supervision
item.description: AMLA has published a reporting package for the identification of provisionally eligible obliged entities, a key preparatory step toward the first selection cycle for entities that will come under AMLA’s direct supervision from 2028.
item.category: Authority for Anti-Money Laundering and Countering the Financing of Terrorism

item.title: AMLA hosts webinar on identification of entities eligible for direct supervision
item.description: AMLA will hold a webinar on 10 June 2026, from 10:00 to 12:00 CEST, to guide participants through the recently published reporting package for the identification of obliged entities eligible for direct supervision.
item.category: Authority for Anti-Money Laundering and Countering the Financing of Terrorism

item.title: AMLA concludes public hearing on draft Guidelines on business-wide risk assessment
item.description: On 28 May 2026, AMLA held a public hearing on the Guidelines on business-wide risk assessment (BWRA), an important milestone in developing the EU's new AML/CFT framework and the risk-based approach.
item.category: Authority for Anti-Money Laundering and Countering the Financing of Terrorism

item.title: AMLA Executive Board Member Rikke-Louise Petersen interviewed by ACAMS moneylaundering.com
item.description: AMLA Executive Board Member Rikke-Louise Petersen spoke to Koos Couvée, Europe Editor at ACAMS moneylaundering.com, about AMLA's approach to supervision and engagement with the private sector.
item.category: Authority for Anti-Money Laundering and Countering the Financing of Terrorism

item.title: AMLA concludes public hearing on draft RTS on group-wide requirements
item.description: On 20 May 2026, AMLA held a public hearing on its draft Regulatory Technical Standards on group-wide requirements, covering the mandates under Articles 16(4) and 17(3) of Regulation (EU) 2024/1624, with over 650 participants attending.
item.category: Authority for Anti-Money Laundering and Countering the Financing of Terrorism

item.title: AMLA Hosts its First Conference
item.description: AMLA’s will host its first conference, Building Trust, Enhancing Integrity: A New Chapter in the EU’s Fight Against Financial Crime, on 9 June 2026 at the Alte Oper in Frankfurt am Main, Germany.
item.category: Authority for Anti-Money Laundering and Countering the Financing of Terrorism

item.title: AMLA Executive Board Member Rikke-Louise Petersen opens ACAMS General Assembly in Frankfurt
item.description: AMLA Executive Board Member Rikke-Louise Petersen delivered a keynote speech at the ACAMS General Assembly in Frankfurt on 12 May 2025, outlining AMLA's progress and priorities for the year ahead.
item.category: Authority for Anti-Money Laundering and Countering the Financing of Terrorism

item.title: AMLA holds public hearings to consult on draft ITS for FIU cooperation
item.description: AMLA is consulting on three draft Implementing Technical Standards that introduce common formats for cooperation between Financial Intelligence Units (FIUs) and between AMLA, FIUs and the European Public Prosecutor's Office (EPPO).
item.category: Authority for Anti-Money Laundering and Countering the Financing of Terrorism

item.title: AMLA Chair Bruna Szego speaks at ACAMS Germany 10th Anniversary event in Berlin
item.description: AMLA Chair Bruna Szego delivered a keynote address at the ACAMS Germany 10th Anniversary event, hosted at the Italian Embassy in Berlin on 6 May 2025.
item.category: Authority for Anti-Money Laundering and Countering the Financing of Terrorism

item.title: AMLA Chair Bruna Szego addresses European Police Congress in Berlin
item.description: AMLA Chair Bruna Szego delivered a keynote address at the European Police Congress in Berlin on 6 May 2025, outlining AMLA's role in fostering European-level financial intelligence to support law enforcement.
item.category: Authority for Anti-Money Laundering and Countering the Financing of Terrorism
